content.welcome: Welcome to Crypto Pets! Your ultimate goal is to hatch, evolve, and collect every single pet in the universe, chasing the rarest mutations to skyrocket your economy.
content.intro: You start with 0 Cash. Move with WASD to collect the gold spawning at the bottom of the map. Use that gold to hatch your very first pet at the Hatchery (Golden Square) and unlock passive income!
content.shopAlbum: Explore the map to upgrade your strategy: visit the Shop (Blue Square) to boost your global stats, and check the Album (Brown Square) to see every creature left to discover.
content.labZoo: Take your pets to the Lab (White Square) to force powerful mutations that multiply their earnings. Then, visit your Zoo (Green Square) to manage your collection and track your active bonuses.
content.trivia: Need gems? Click on asteroids going aroung the Space map or click the Trivia button at the top-right to test your knowledge! Answering correctly rewards you with precious Gems, the fuel needed for cosmic expansion.
content.spaceCenter: Ready to look at the stars? The Space Center (Aqua Square) pulls real-time data from NASA, granting you massive, permanent income multipliers based on real asteroids spotted today!
content.cosmicGate: Once you unlock the Cosmic Gate, use your Gems to travel into Space! There, you'll explore a new map, hatch alien eggs, collect extraterrestrial species, and generate passive Cosmic Gems.
content.rebirth: When your cosmic power peaks, unleash a Rebirth! You will sacrifice your current wallet and pets in exchange for a massive, permanent +20% income multiplier that stacks forever.
content.extra: Manage your stats, play the cyberpunk soundtrack, or toggle the Dark/Light Mode on the right panel. That's everything. Go out and conquer the pet universe!

1.step1: Move with W-A-S-D or the pad below. Follow the path and collect 500$

2.step1: Now you have enough to hatch your first egg, then you need to place your new pet in your Zoo. Click 'Home' when you are done.
2.step2: Click the 'Buy' button and hatch your first pet
2.step3: Place the new pet in your Zoo

3.step1: Now your pet is making you earn money every second. Visit the shop to buy your first upgrade.
3.step2: Wait until you have 1000$, then buy your first gold upgrade

4.step1: Take a look at the Space Center
4.step2: When you have enough money, you can activate a special bonus and travel to Space

5.step1: Check the Lab, where you can mutate your pets.
5.step2: You will be able to mutate pets to increase their specific earnings

6.step2: You can see all your owned pets here, including their mutation

7.step2: The album shows all the pets in the game and which ones you're missing
7.step3: Let's go back and start to play!
